title: Rachel Cusk on Her Novel ‘Life of M,’ Gossip and Natalie Portman
summary: “Life of M,” Rachel Cusk’s new book, has a protagonist with an uncanny resemblance to Natalie Portman. But in an interview, Cusk says she never expected it would cause such a frenzy.
